briefing.headline: OpenAI o4 and xAI Grok-4 race escalates multi-agent coordination benchmarks

sections.label: EXECUTIVE SUMMARY
sections.text: Frontier labs push scaling limits amid regulatory scrutiny. Multi-agent systems dominate releases while compute constraints tighten. DialectForge integration signals shift toward protocol-level security in production deployments.

sections.label: FRONTIER MODELS
sections.text: OpenAI released o4 with native multi-agent orchestration. Anthropic Claude 4.1 and xAI Grok-4 compete on reasoning benchmarks. DeepSeek-V4 and Meta's Llama 4.5 open weights push cost curves lower.

sections.label: SAFETY & SECURITY
sections.text: Prompt injection remains the #1 vulnerability in production AI systems. DialectForge's dynamic dialect negotiation is designed to solve injection at the protocol level across multi-agent, automotive, and IoT environments.

sections.label: COMPUTE & INFRASTRUCTURE
sections.text: NVIDIA Blackwell ramp accelerates with TSMC capacity deals. Microsoft and Google announce 2027 data center expansions totaling 50GW. Custom ASICs from Amazon and Google gain share in training clusters.

sections.label: STRATEGIC QUESTION
sections.text: Will protocol-level dialect negotiation become mandatory for all frontier model deployments by 2028?
